description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with Git repositories and managing plugin extensions in a project. It includes functions to list changed paths, detect changed extension IDs, and verify extensions' existence based on paths and Git commits.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a Git command with specified arguments and options, returning the output as a string.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a file path to use forward slashes for cross-platform consistency.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks whether a given Git reference or commit hash exists in the repository.

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Determines the best base revision for calculating changed paths, considering fallback options.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of file paths that have changed between two Git revisions.

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension package.json exists for a given extension ID.

methods.name: listAvailableExtensionIds
methods.description: Lists all extension IDs that have a valid package.json in the extensions directory.

methods.name: detectChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Identifies extension IDs affected based on a list of changed file paths.

methods.name: listChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: High-level function that combines other utilities to list extension IDs changed between revisions.
